system_sql.action: weekly trend of dashboard performance metrics for the APAC region
system_sql.sql:
WITH weekly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        date_trunc('week', o.order_date)::date AS week,
        COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE 
        c.region = 'APAC'
    GROUP BY 
        c.region, week
),
weekly_refunds AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        date_trunc('week', r.created_at)::date AS week,
        COUNT(r.id) AS total_refunds,
        SUM(r.amount) AS total_refund_amount
    FROM 
        refunds r
    JOIN 
        orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
    JOIN 
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE 
        c.region = 'APAC'
    GROUP BY 
        c.region, week
),
weekly_support_tickets AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        date_trunc('week', s.created_at)::date AS week,
        COUNT(s.id) AS total_support_tickets,
        AVG(s.resolution_time) AS avg_resolution_time
    FROM 
        support_tickets s
    JOIN 
        customers c ON s.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE 
        c.region = 'APAC'
    GROUP BY 
        c.region, week
)
SELECT 
    o.region,
    o.week,
    COALESCE(o.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(o.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(r.total_refunds, 0) AS total_refunds,
    COALESCE(r.total_refund_amount, 0) AS total_refund_amount,
    COALESCE(s.total_support_tickets, 0) AS total_support_tickets,
    COALESCE(s.avg_resolution_time, 0) AS avg_resolution_time
FROM 
    weekly_orders o
FULL OUTER JOIN 
    weekly_refunds r ON o.region = r.region AND o.week = r.week
FULL OUTER JOIN 
    weekly_support_tickets s ON o.region = s.region AND o.week = s.week
WHERE 
    o.week >= '2025-03-03' AND o.week < '2025-05-26'
ORDER BY 
    o.region, o.week
